decisions.basis: Memory must depend on signature/profile and one model, not the number of interpretations visited.
decisions.choice: Enumerate canonical finite interpretations with mixed-radix counters, not a cached product of predicate powersets.

decisions.basis: Avoid huge integer/tuple-space allocation while preserving exact finite scope and first-witness search.
decisions.choice: Keep exact symbolic interpretation factors when a count is large; cap enumeration digits only beyond the interpretation budget, with completeness explicitly false.

decisions.basis: A target is never silently assumed, and vacuity does not become target support.
decisions.choice: Check T and all required populations jointly before Q; use separate witness, countermodel and bounded-validity query modes.

decisions.basis: Execution states cannot establish logical absence or unbounded conclusions.
decisions.choice: Return resource-limit/timeout/cancelled without absence evidence; a checked first witness may support only its exact existential/model statement.

decisions.basis: An earlier pending-adapter observation is not rewritten after implementation.
decisions.choice: Preserve sealed P01 runtime assessment as its historical epoch; bind the new provider implementation directly in this unit.

task_contract.closeout: Bind actual inputs/outputs/provider and criterion results; append project-local status; preserve prior candidate evidence.
task_contract.edge_cases: Two independently derived theories replay; bounded no-witness never claims unbounded separation/consistency; resource exhaustion is unknown; memory bounded by profile.
task_contract.failure_behavior: Emit failed or explicit unresolved outcome; preserve inputs and last successful bundle. No silently skipped obligation.
task_contract.ordered_rules: Enumerate the exact finite interpretation rather than the two fixed pilot IDs; stream a first witness and counters; record domain and exhaustion completeness; enforce cancellation and resource limits.
task_contract.pre_execution_check: Rehash declared source and upstream receipts; verify exact source/currentness, semantic closure and absent outputs. Future outputs need not exist before creation.

validation.reviewable_check: Two independently derived theories replay; bounded no-witness never claims unbounded separation/consistency; resource exhaustion is unknown; memory bounded by profile.
validation.runner_state: Declared same-unit post-produce test output; no dependency on the later I04 CLI.
